name: Grafana Alerts
author: dDan4a
description: Firing alerts from one or more Grafana and Prometheus Alertmanager instances in the Omarchy bar: severity badge, alert list grouped by instance, desktop notifications, one-key silence, list and expire active silences, local do not disturb, who is on call in Grafana OnCall and your next shifts. Works in demo mode without a server.

barWidget.description: Firing Grafana / Alertmanager alerts with notifications and silences

schema.label: Instances file
schema.description: JSON list of Grafana / Alertmanager instances, see the README. When it does not exist, the Grafana URL below is used.

schema.label: Grafana URL (single instance)
schema.description: Used only without an instances file, e.g. https://grafana.example.com. Leave both empty for demo mode.

schema.label: Service account token file
schema.description: A file holding only the token (chmod 600). The token is kept out of shell.json.
